articles.title: Heard on the Street Friday Recap: Record Highs Again
articles.mainIdea: Heard on the Street Friday Recap: Record Highs Again
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Heard on the Street Friday Recap: Record Highs Again. The unemployment rate ticked down to 4.4%. The report capped a weak year for hiring and cleared the way for the Federal Reserve to hold rates steady at its late-January meeting. The White House confirmed that President Trump posted job-market statistics online Thursday that were supposed to remain confidential until the next day. Related tickers mentioned: OKLO, VST, ^IXIC.
